name: Donchian breakout with bandwidth expansion (1h)
rationale: A break to the top of the 1h channel is only taken when Bollinger bandwidth is ABOVE a floor — i.e. bands are already expanding, confirming real energy behind the move. This filters the fake breakouts that occur in tight, low-energy ranges where a channel high is meaningless. The other side is the fader who shorts every range high and is squeezed when the breakout is backed by genuine volatility. Edge persists because expansion-confirmed breakouts have far higher continuation odds than naive ones. Distinct from the squeeze spec (which requires prior COMPRESSION); here we want concurrent expansion. Disconfirmer: exits when price re-enters the range, or the stop fires.
catalyst: channel-high break confirmed by expanding bands
